name: Admin Secure Link Management
description: Admin views, searches and filters secure links by ready, sent, opened, expired and revoked lifecycle states, including received links and audit history. The admin can manually mark an active team-created link as sent, which records the acknowledgement without sending a message; can reveal content without consuming the public link, copy its URL, edit it, revoke, reactivate or delete it. A recipient explicitly revealing the public link changes the displayed lifecycle to opened; reactivation returns it to ready.
